name: Showback
short_description: A FinOps practice of showing teams the costs attributed to them without transferring the amount out of their budgets, building cost awareness before any chargeback.

evidence.quote: Others simply show teams their costs in a process called showback.
Then showback comes first. Showback is just reporting.
The real behavior change happens when you move from showback to chargeback.
Showback changes behavior because it removes the shared illusion.
Showback is usually the first step. Chargeback might come later.
